name: v0.3.19 finding-gated return-entry drain
one_shot_semantics: After this protocol commit and the later candidate-freeze commit, run the 12 preregistered new candidate cells once. Rerun only an exact cell that fails for infrastructure reasons. Do not add finding-stop, dead-action special cases, button-effect prediction, text ranking, link or input or select drain, login or result special cases, cross-hub behavior changes, budget changes, target exceptions, full-transfer changes, or outcome-gate changes after the first target result.
research_question: Can Return-Entry Drain be permitted only when the same browser step creates a new sequence_terminal outcome=finding that transitions the live branch from returning false to true, while an ordinary sequence_horizon_reached transition falls back to frozen v0.3.17 behavior?
not: permission to rewrite v0.3.14, v0.3.15, v0.3.16, v0.3.17, or v0.3.18 evidence
permission to change the product default
permission to retune after the first target result

trigger_context_audit.finding_stop_rule: if any local probe produces a finding, stop the drain immediately
trigger_context_audit.lab_finding_stop_counterexample: step 17 btn_close carries lab_note_visibility and step 18 btn_reopen carries lab_reopen_clears inside the same result drain
trigger_context_audit.deep_harmful_epoch: step 7 horizon return-entry start, step 8 btn_login same-hub dead_action, step 9 btn_demo_login leaves the hub, return_success 0
trigger_context_audit.lab_useful_epoch: step 16 finding-terminal return-entry start on the result hub, then btn_close and btn_reopen, L9 confirmed

candidate.trigger: After snapshotting returning, the active branch, the sequence-event length, and the open sequence instance, run inherited v0.3.18 after-processing. Start Return-Entry Drain only when every v0.3.18 state condition holds and the same step appended a new sequence_terminal outcome=finding for the live return sequence.
trigger_requirements: the new events contain a sequence_terminal whose outcome is finding
that terminal belongs to the live active branch, correlated by sequence_instance_id when present and otherwise by branch identity on the same step
the terminal was not present before the step
the same step did not physically complete or conservatively unwind the branch
candidate.horizon_non_trigger: A false-to-true return caused only by sequence_horizon_reached, with no same-step sequence_terminal outcome=finding, must not start Return-Entry Drain. Emit audit-only finding_return_entry_horizon_bypassed with behavior v0317_fallback.
candidate.same_step_correlation: Inspect only events appended during the step. Do not use a page-local finding, a global finding count, or a recent finding.

safety_before_target_evaluation.horizon_differential: Horizon-only false-to-true transitions match v0.3.17 on return selection, return attempts, active branch, parent, return-cycle history, and drained-key state. Fixtures may model Deep, CRM, Wiki, and a generic horizon shape without app-specific decision logic.
safety_before_target_evaluation.inherited_RE_X: v0.3.18 RE1-RE16 and X1-X10 stay unchanged and must still pass
safety_before_target_evaluation.model_rule: Only F may activate Return-Entry Drain. H must enter the historical return path and must never activate drain.

outcomes.C: protocol or freeze invalid, historical source mutation, post-freeze semantic edit, safety or model failure, horizon-only Return-Entry Drain, a non-finding or wrong-instance or reused trigger, duplicate terminal, return-attempt or return-cycle or parent or repeated-key violation, directory false handoff, CRM or Ops collapse, any Desk or Deep or Wiki or Shop Guard loss, app-specific logic, or a product default change
outcomes.D: safety and protocol pass, but the Lab finding-terminal return-entry mechanism does not engage
outcomes.B: safety, protocol, and historical regression pass and the finding-gated drain engages, but Outcome A is incomplete
outcomes.A: protocol, freeze, FG safety, horizon differential safety, and the 66429-trace model pass, the Lab finding-trigger mechanism gate passes, Lab retains L1 L2 L8 L9 L10, Deep has no horizon drain and retains D6 D7 D11 D12 D13 D14, Directory, Forum, Billing, CRM, Ops, Desk, Wiki, and Shop preservation gates pass, trigger and return-entry violations are zero, there is no app-specific logic, and the product default is unchanged

outcome_a_scope: Inspected trigger-narrowing repair only. Not fresh validation, not generalization, and not promotion. If Outcome A, the next round must be a new preregistered fresh validation with new target identities.
